Article 5 (Limits on Public Disclosure of Investigation Details, etc.)
The following circumstances shall constitute justifiable grounds under Article 9 (3) of the Act:
1. Where there is an overriding need in the public interest to make a disclosure in order to prevent seriously inaccurate or speculative reports that infringe the honor, privacy or other human rights of persons involved in a case or impede an investigation, or for comparable unavoidable reasons;
2. Where, at the time of instituting a public prosecution, the results of investigations into related cases in which no prosecution is instituted are announced.
